scope: Fresh live-AI text conversations with adaptive control references, deterministic numeric checks, persistence between turns, and unchanged homework. Not microphone or student usability evidence.

results.request: I know people say keep the equation balanced, but I don’t really get what is being kept. Explain without doing my homework.

result.message: An equation says the left side and right side have the same value. “Keeping it balanced” means making the same change to both sides, so they remain equal. Here, 7*x+5 and 26 are equal; no homework steps have been done.

results.request: Could I try taking different amounts off each side together, with something adjustable here? Keep my actual equation as it is.

result.message: Adjust the two sliders to try different amounts. Taking the same amount from both sides keeps them equal; different amounts change the balance. Your saved equation stays unchanged.

content.title: Taking amounts off both sides
content.description: Adjust each slider to remove an amount from that side. Compare the results: equal amounts preserve the balance; different amounts change it. This exploration does not change your saved equation.

readouts.label: Left minus right (using the original equality)

results.request: I moved Amount off the left side to 1. What changed, and what stayed the same? Don’t adjust it again.

result.message: You took 1 off the left side and 0 off the right. So the left side became 1 less than the right, and the equation is no longer balanced. Your saved equation, 7*x+5=26, stayed the same; only the interactive example changed.
